summary: A Depth 50 subscription on NSE: the book comes from the TBT socket, its quote from the HSM symbol feed; a TBT diff updates the levels it names and a level emptied leaves the book.

deviations.reason: The web's Fyers quote carries the best bid and ask with sizes; A key the web sends from some mode up is sent in that mode and every mode above it, so a script reading it on the richer frame meets no KeyError (feed/dialect/names.rs rules, docs/port/market-data-frames.md).

The web's 50-level frame carries depth_levels, feed_time, is_50_depth and the TBT totals as total_buy_qty / total_sell_qty; the carrier has none of these yet (lane wire step 2: Fyers 50-level meta keys).
The web stamps the 50-level frame with int(time.time()), epoch seconds; feed timestamps are epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md), as the desktop sends them.
The web's 50-level frame names the Fyers ticker (NSE:SBIN-EQ) as token, its HSM frames the exchange token; the desktop sends the master's fytoken in both (lane wire step 2: Fyers 50-level meta keys).

The 50-level book frame carries the instrument's latest quote, the quote's update_type with it (1.0.6 decision, kept: the depth frame keeps ltp, timestamp and the latest quote); the web's TBT frame has the book's keys alone.
